Tredjepartsfiler som er lagt lokalt i repoet (ingen eksterne CDN-er):
- plotly-basic.min.js: Plotly.js 2.35.2 (basic), MIT-lisens, https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js
- ../fonts/ibm-plex-sans-*.woff2: IBM Plex Sans, SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://github.com/IBM/plex
- ../fonts/newsreader-latin-wght-normal.woff2: Newsreader, SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://github.com/productiontype/Newsreader
